title: Do Not Drink Advisory — Zone 1 Water Quality Issue

fields.org: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer
fields.headline: DO NOT DRINK TAP WATER IN ZONE 1 — City Investigates Possible Contamination
fields.subhead: Customers are advised to use bottled water for drinking, cooking, and brushing teeth.
fields.body:
The City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer is investigating a possible chemical contamination in tap water serving Zone 1, bounded by Oak Street, Hilltop Drive, River Road, and Maple Avenue.

Early today, lab tests detected a finished-water pH of 9.3 and a caustic dose of 38 mg/L — both significantly above safe levels. The HMI system continues to display normal values, but field instruments and grab samples confirm a mismatch. The city has isolated the affected portion of the distribution system and is operating manually.

As a precaution, residents in Zone 1 are instructed to: do not drink tap water, do not cook with it, do not make ice, and do not give it to pets. Use bottled water for all consumption. Showering and hand washing are permitted for adults, but avoid prolonged skin contact.

The city is working with the Ohio EPA and Carver County Public Health to confirm the source and begin flushing and sampling. An all-clear will be issued only after independent verification and regulatory approval.

Questions? Call (555) 031-2222 or visit millbrook-oh.example/water.
